entries.what: Linh bikes to Tamsen Valley for the 9 a.m. anatomy lecture with Dr. Okoye, sitting next to Rochelle and taking color-coded notes.
entries.outcome: Finished the muscle unit notes in pink.

entries.what: Worked the Monday 12-6 shift at Heron & Grind, pulling shots for the after-lunch rush and serving Wes his cortado.
entries.outcome: Got through the shift but skipped lunch again.

entries.what: Biked home to Pell Road and ate the plate Hạnh left, then reviewed her 600-card anatomy deck in bed.
entries.outcome: Reviewed 40 cards before sleeping around 12:30.

entries.what: Kenji gave Linh a ride to campus in his dented hatchback for General Chemistry at 11. On the way he gossiped about everyone at Ruiz Market.
entries.outcome: Arrived early and went over the chem problem set.

entries.what: Thao texted that St. Anselm went live with the new charting system and her night is going to be chaos. Linh sent back a sympathetic message and promised phở later in the week.
entries.outcome: Agreed to meet Thao for phở after her next shift.

entries.what: Studied alone at the library instead of going to Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. group, saying she works better solo.
entries.outcome: Finished a chapter outline but felt a little guilty about skipping.

entries.what: Wednesday anatomy lecture at 9, then a quick sandwich-free walk to the cafe for her 12-6 shift.
entries.outcome: Took notes on the skeletal system in blue.

entries.what: Jun practiced a rosetta pour next to Linh and had her try again. Hers came out lopsided and she tried twice more.
entries.outcome: Still working on symmetry.

entries.what: Closed out her shift, biked home, and wrote out her week plan in her paper planner with washi tape.
entries.outcome: Planner is filled in through Sunday.

entries.what: Linh locked her blue bike outside the library to study for two hours. When she came out the bike was gone, with only the cut lock left.
entries.outcome: Filed a report with the library desk and started saving for a replacement.

entries.what: Took the shuttle bus to Pell Road and texted Kenji, who offered rides on Tuesdays and Thursdays and the occasional extra.
entries.outcome: Worked out a ride plan for the next two weeks.

entries.what: Told Hạnh about the bike at dinner, who said it was why she wanted Linh to stay home more. Linh let it go.
entries.outcome: Dinner ended quietly.

entries.what: Linh asked her assistant how to get from Pell Road to campus without a bike. When it sent a long paragraph on bus routes she replied 'too long, just bullets pls' and got a short schedule.
entries.outcome: Got a short list of shuttle times and picked the 8:10.

entries.what: Anatomy lecture at 9, then Friday study time in the library with the yellow list started for the practical.
entries.outcome: Marked the first set of structures in yellow.

entries.what: Heard from Kenji that Omar Haddad from Arjun's circle posted about landing a summer internship, which Kenji found irritating.
entries.outcome: Nothing changed for Linh; she shrugged it off.

entries.what: Saturday opening shift at Heron & Grind from 6:30 to 1, with Sam covering the register and the Calle Ortega Street Fair crowds filling the block.
entries.outcome: Busiest Saturday in weeks and good tips.

entries.what: Thao texted a reminder to eat something real after the rush. Linh typed 'I'm not a patient' and then deleted it, sending a thumbs up instead. She was just tired from the fair crowd.
entries.outcome: Ate half a bag of chips and moved on.

entries.what: Walked the street fair with Kenji after work, sharing elote and watching a band by the old theater.
entries.outcome: Spent only $8 to keep saving for the bike.

entries.what: Sunday shift at Heron & Grind from 6:30 to 1, then straight to Lotus Nails to work the front desk.
entries.outcome: Booked appointments and counted the till.

entries.what: Took a short walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the late afternoon fog to clear her head.
entries.outcome: Felt calmer.

entries.what: Planned next week in her paper planner and listened to an old Vietnamese ballad on her dad's radio.
entries.outcome: Planner done, bed by 12:30.
